records.text: Houndmaster Loksey is a Scarlet Monastery houndmaster who commands the kennel’s hounds in battle, releasing them when challenged and using Bloodlust to strengthen the fight.
Herod, the Scarlet Champion, meets challengers with confidence and fights with sweeping blades and cleaves. His battle cries invoke the Light for strength, and he taunts opponents he has defeated.

Scarlet Commander Mograine is a Scarlet military leader whose fierce calls demand purification of those he considers impure. In the Ashbringer’s presence, he recognizes the blade as his father’s, asks forgiveness, and urges its bearer to lead his soldiers in a purge. The scene turns when his father appears; Mograine’s final words plead for forgiveness.

High Inquisitor Whitemane is a Scarlet Crusade inquisitor stationed at the Monastery in Tirisfal. She fights beside Scarlet Commander Mograine and, when he falls, calls on the Light to raise him as her champion. Her words frame their battle as a sacred cause and Mograine’s defeat as treachery.

Vorrel Sengutz is a Forsaken captive at the Scarlet Monastery, weakened by weeks of torture at Interrogator Vishas’s hands. He says Vishas took his wedding ring and gave it to his own wife, Nancy, and asks for revenge while making clear that his final wish is for the ring to reach his wife, Monika, in Tarren Mill. His plea carries both bitterness and resignation.

Interrogator Vishas is a Scarlet Crusade interrogator at the Monastery, feared by Vorrel Sengutz for torturing him over weeks and taking his wedding ring. In combat Vishas demands secrets, threatens to tear them from his victims, and calls their suffering a purge by pain. Vorrel says Vishas gave the ring to his wife, Nancy.
A Scarlet Crusade sentry who warns enemies that the Crusade will destroy those carrying the Scourge’s taint. He calls on the Crusade to smite the wicked and drive evil from the land.
A Scarlet Crusade augur who fights with spells.
A Scarlet Crusade disciple who fights with spells.
A Scarlet Crusade soldier who proclaims the Crusade's mission to destroy the Scourge's taint. His combat training includes improved blocking.
A Scarlet Crusade gallant who denounces evil and the Scourge's taint, invoking the Light as he attacks.
A Scarlet Crusade beastmaster who repeats the order's condemnations of evil and the Scourge's taint. In combat, this rank uses a ranged shot.
A Scarlet Crusade evoker who voices the order's zeal and threats against those it deems tainted by the Scourge.
A Scarlet Crusade guardsman who calls for the order to smite evil and the Scourge's taint. In combat, this rank adopts a defensive stance.
A Scarlet Crusade diviner who condemns perceived Scourge taint and calls on the Light to destroy the wicked. In combat, this rank casts Fireball.
A Scarlet Crusade protector who denounces Scourge taint and vows the Crusade will destroy the wicked. The rank's combat support includes Devotion Aura.
A Scarlet Crusade sorcerer who joins the order's threats against those it brands tainted. Their Ashbringer cries turn to awed commands to kneel before the weapon.

A Scarlet Crusade myrmidon who echoes the order's vow to smite the wicked. In combat, this martial rank joins its fellows in condemning Scourge taint; at the Ashbringer, its speech becomes awed calls to kneel.
A Scarlet Crusade adept who threatens those it judges tainted by the Scourge and echoes the order's vow to smite the wicked.
A Scarlet Crusade conjuror who calls for the Crusade to destroy those tainted by the Scourge and can summon a fire elemental.
A Scarlet Crusade defender who invokes the Crusade against Scourge-tainted foes and reacts to the Ashbringer with reverence, demanding that others kneel.

A Scarlet Crusade chaplain who calls for the Crusade to smite its enemies and seeks to live long enough to see a lord purge the world of infidels. The chaplain also reacts to the Ashbringer with reverence.
A Scarlet Crusade wizard who calls for the Crusade to destroy those tainted by the Scourge and reacts to the Ashbringer with reverence, demanding that others kneel.
A Scarlet Crusade centurion who calls for the Crusade to smite its enemies and reacts to the Ashbringer with reverence. In battle, the centurion uses Battle Shout.
A Scarlet Crusade champion who vows to destroy those carrying the Scourge’s taint. The Ashbringer leaves him awestruck and prompts him to demand that others kneel before it.

A Scarlet Abbot who preaches the Crusade’s mission to smite the wicked and drive out evil. He can heal an ally with Renew, yet when confronted he also pleads with a Lord or Lady to purge the infidels and let him live.
A Scarlet Crusade torturer who demands confession and promises release, while admitting that he enjoys inflicting pain regardless of what a victim has to say.
The Unfettered Spirit is an undead creature. The Pendant of Myzrael is linked to one such spirit and starts a vision-led search for a crystal in the northern mountains of Arathi.
A Scarlet Crusade monk whose speech names the Ashbringer and commands others to kneel before it; he also pleads with a Lord or Lady to purge the infidels.
In a particular exchange, High Inquisitor Fairbanks thanks a hero for lifting a curse. He also wields Curse of Blood and Dispel Magic, pairing a personal concern with a practiced use of magic.

Bloodmage Thalnos voices vengeance and hunger: he calls for rest for the angry dead and demands more souls. His battle cries frame him as a wrathful, soul-seeking bloodmage, using shadow and flame spells against those he confronts.
Anguished Dead is an undead creature. It uses Veil of Shadows in combat.
The Haunting Phantasm calls up an illusory phantasm in battle, extending its eerie presence through a summoned image.

Arcanist Doan fiercely defends the mysteries from defilement and calls his punishment of intruders “righteous fire.” In battle he uses Arcane Explosion and Silence, answering intrusion with forceful arcane magic.
The Fallen Champion is a martial opponent whose attacks include Cleave, Strike, and Rend, relying on direct physical assaults in battle.
Ironspine is a rare undead whose combat repertoire includes Curse of Weakness and Poison Cloud.
Azshir the Sleepless is a rare undead whose combat repertoire includes Call of the Grave and Terrify.
